root_cause: The header component sets aria-hidden="true" on the navigation menu on desktop because it initializes based solely on the absence of the 'govuk-header__navigation--open' class, without considering that the menu button is hidden via CSS and the navigation is visibly displayed. This hides the navigation links from assistive technology.
repair_strategy: Modify the header component's init method to detect whether the menu button is visible (mobile view). If the button is hidden (desktop), treat the navigation as permanently visible and set aria-hidden="false". Only add the click listener when the button is visible.
expected_accessibility_effect: The navigation links will be exposed as links in the accessibility tree on desktop, allowing keyboard and screen reader users to reach and activate them.
functional_risks: Minimal; the change only affects desktop where the menu button is hidden. Mobile toggle behavior unchanged.
Potential risk if getComputedStyle forces layout, but it's a one-time check on init.
verification_requirements: Run the existing journey test; ensure ax assertions for "Apply", "Renew a licence", "Fishing rules" pass.
Verify mobile toggle still works (manual check).
